job_spec.name: turetryphy-xf-8577223b2-a-tc-rd-cl
job_spec.element: HBM protected TU PHY retry port
job_spec.purpose: tu-retry-1011: cp-9e7cf26ca-b post-CTS TT -115 / 1,110 endpoints, 883 launched by u_retry.fault; pclk skew ~20-90 ps (not the clock). Root cause: high-fanout control/select nets fed by deep ready/feedback cones. XF=1: rx landing OREG=0 + pointer skid with replicated pointers (rx_ready off 582-b d0/d1 enables, -115); in_ready from flops (tx credit nz, port credits nz, FBPRE window); FBPRE: base/next_seq feedback compares one cycle early (-79..-30); SFPIPE sflag set +1 edge (-50); replicated ingress head / skid pointers (-41/-48). 0 cycles, cycle-exact (FBPRE_CHECK). RVT, route hold margin 0.025 ns.
